Practical model guidance
Plot before trusting the model

Start with observed-vs-fitted and residual views. Multiple regression assumes the conditional mean of Y is linear in the predictors, not just that the coefficients can be estimated.

Coefficients are conditional

Each slope describes how predicted Y changes as that predictor changes while the other predictors in the model are held constant.

Collinearity warning

The predictor set shows elevated overlap (max VIF = 563.85). Coefficients can become unstable even when overall R^2 looks strong.

Small-sample caution

With multiple predictors and a modest sample, p-values and confidence intervals become more sensitive to outliers, non-normal residuals, and collinearity.
